sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 564 was established by Ordinance No. 24073, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 27, 1999. Ordinance No. 24073 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 564 is established on two tracts of property: the first tract fronts on the southeast line of Clarendon Drive, northeast of Fleming Avenue; and the second tract fronts on the southeast line of the Dallas Area Rapid Transit Light Rail right-of-way, northwest of Ewing Avenue. The size of PD 564 is approximately 23.5536 acres. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article, PAPERMILL means a facility for sorting, cleaning, and gulping of used paper, and for production of paper products.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 564A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Papermill.

(b) Except as provided in Subsection (a), the uses permitted in this district are all uses permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this planned development district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District is subject to DIR in this planned development district; etc. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

The development standards contained in Section 51A-4.123(d), "Industrial Manufacturing (IM) District," apply to this planned development district, except as otherwise required by these conditions.

(1) Front, side, and rear yard. For a papermill use, front, side, and rear yards must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(2) Height. For a papermill use, maximum structure height is 45 feet. For all other uses permitted in an IM Industrial Manufacturing District, maximum structure height is 110 feet. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) For a papermill use, off-street parking and loading must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(b) For all other uses, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(c) Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.110. LANDSCAPING.

All landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.112. ACCESS.

For a papermill use, ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.113. FENCING.

The existing six-foot-high fence shown on the development plan must be maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-564.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 564 is located on Zoning Map No. L-7. (Ord. Nos. 24073; 25163)
